charts.title: Market size of the global health club industry from 2009 to 2019 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Total revenue of the global health club industry 2009-2019
charts.description: The statistic depicts the global market size of the health club industry from 2009 to 2019. In 2019, the global health and fitness club industry generated estimated revenues of 96.7 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Total number of health clubs worldwide from 2009 to 2019, by region
charts.short: Health clubs - total number by region worldwide 2009-2019
charts.description: This graph depicts the number of health clubs worldwide by region from 2009 to 2019. In Europe, there were an estimated 63,644 health clubs in 2019.

charts.title: Revenue of the yoga industry in the United States from 2012 to 2020 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.description: The statistic shows revenue of the yoga industry in the United States in 2012, 2015 and 2020. In 2015, yoga industry revenue amounted to 9.09 billion U.S. dollars in the United States.

charts.title: U.S. yoga and pilates industry segmentation in 2015, by products/services
charts.short: Yoga and pilates products & services market share in the U.S. 2015
charts.description: The statistic shows products and services segmentation of the U.S. yoga and pilates market in 2015. The industry generated 51.3 percent of its revenue from yoga classes.

charts.title: Number of yoga participants in the United States from 2010 to 2023 (in millions)
charts.description: In 2023, the number of people doing yoga in the United States continued a downward trend which began in the previous year. In 2022, around 34 million U.S. Americans reported having done yoga at least once in that year. By 2023, that number had declined to roughly 33.64 million, denoting a 1.8 percent decrease in yoga participants in the North American country between 2022 and 2023.
charts.note: United States; 6 years and older; including people who participated in the activity at least once in each given year; *Total number of respondents in 2023. Figures were rounded. Read more
charts.source: Outdoor Foundation; SFIA; Sports Marketing Surveys USA

charts.title: Number of pilates participants in the United States from 2010 to 2023 (in millions)
charts.description: There were 11.86 million people who participated in pilates training in the United States in 2023, denoting an increase of 15 percent versus the previous year. This marked the highest annual figure for pilates participants in the U.S. since 2010.
charts.note: United States; 6 years and older; including people who participated in the activity at least once in each given year; *Total number of respondents in 2023. Figures were rounded. Read more
charts.source: Outdoor Foundation; SFIA; Sports Marketing Surveys USA
